LESSON: READING 7.4.1 CHARACTERS IN CLASS READERS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you tell the difference between a main and a minor character in a story?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify minor characters in a text
2. discuss the relationships between different minor characters in the text
3. appreciate the place of minor characters in the class reader

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 7.4.1 CHARACTERS IN CLASS READERS
This lesson teaches Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify minor characters in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. discuss the relationships between different minor characters in the text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the place of minor characters in the class reader
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers above.
2. Explain Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 7.4.1 Characters in Class Readers important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you tell the difference between a main and a minor character in a story?
2. How would you describe the behaviour of your classmates?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify minor characters in a text
2. discuss the relationships between different minor characters in the text
3. appreciate the place of minor characters in the class reader
